spoken.TUT_G1_SELECT_WHY: First, the planet's panel shows what it sells, what it buys, and what the company can trade there.
spoken.TUT_G2_BUY_WHY: Then, a Buy order fills your storage on this planet each cycle.
spoken.TUT_G3_SEND_WHY: Next, pick a planet that wants the good. A route carries your goods there by ship.
spoken.TUT_G4_ROUTE_PAY_WHY: Now, the route earns when it sells there. That is where your money comes from.
spoken.TUT_G5_UPKEEP_WHY: Meanwhile, a ship costs money every cycle, so a route must earn more than it costs.
spoken.TUT_G6_SELL_WHY: After that, a Sell order turns your stock into credits.
spoken.TUT_G7_STORAGE_WHY: Also, company storage holds your goods on a planet. When it is full, Buy waits.
spoken.TUT_G8_SKILLS_WHY: Later on, spend an expansion point. Skills unlock bigger storage, longer routes and the permit.
spoken.TUT_G9_PERMIT_WHY: To expand, the Permit Charter lets you open a new system, and a new system has more planets to trade with.
spoken.TUT_G10_DONE_WHY: Finally, open Competitors to see shares. Market chain choices change your rivals.
spoken.TUT_GALAXY_INTRO_WHY: Here, each system is its own market. Seeing them side by side shows where to grow next.
spoken.TUT_GALAXY_ICONS_WHY: Also, a system that has what another lacks is where a route pays best.
spoken.TUT_GALAXY_ROUTES_WHY: Then, open a system to set up buy, send and sell orders there.
